verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the headline is shrunk to tiny type in five stacked lines jammed against the top-left edge, which wastes the banner's width when it should read left to right. The red T has been pulled away from the text and pushed to the far right, so the original's text-on-T layering is gone. That leaves a big dead blue gap in the middle and the message barely readable at this size.
